title: 3D Reconstruction and Voxel Heating in Digital Composites
summary: Measuring soft robotic motion through marker tracking and 3D reconstruction, and fabricating silicone specimens with different internal cavity sizes for heating studies.
contribution: Marker tracking, camera calibration, fixture evaluation, mold CAD, and specimen fabrication.
evidence: Motion-tracking comparisons, stereo reconstruction results, fabrication photographs, and the research poster. Thermal testing of the new specimens is pending.
alt: Soft robotic tail with fluorescent markers mounted for motion tracking

title: Point Defects in Cubic Beryllium Sulfide
summary: Investigating how atomic-scale defects affect the stability, electronic structure, and optical response of cubic beryllium sulfide through first-principles calculations.
contribution: Analysis of defect structures and electronic and optical behavior, interpretation of results, and research presentation.
evidence: Defect visualizations, optical spectra, and the research poster.
alt: Crystal structure from the cubic BeS point-defect study

title: Hybrid Fiber-Reinforced Polymer Composites
summary: Comparing how jute, E-glass, and combined fiber reinforcement affect epoxy composites through specimen fabrication and tensile, flexural, and dynamic mechanical testing.
contribution: Laminate fabrication, specimen preparation, mechanical and dynamic testing, and analysis of material response.
evidence: Specimen photographs and dynamic mechanical analysis comparisons across the three composite systems.
alt: Composite specimens from the jute, glass, and hybrid study
